changes: Added to notes: the era is only 'saṃvat', and VS was inferred from the Devanagari script and the late Nepalese context.

notes: The catalogue gives the date as SAM 1846, but the colophon reads saṃvat 18|43, so 1843. The colophon names no era. It is taken as VS because of the Devanagari script and the period, which gives 1786 CE (Oct/Nov). The colophon names no scribe, owner or place.
